attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 14 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **Three head names on one page, so three folders**, which is `docs/CORPUS.md` §10.1: the page carries «Αγιος Αλεξανδρος», «Αγιος Βαρβαρος» and «Αγιος Ακολουθος» as three separate head entries with one shared notice, and the notice's couplet counts them — «Tριών συνάθλων ταις τετμημέναις κάραις, Tρία Tριάς τίθησιν άξια στέφη», for the severed heads of three fellow contenders the Trinity sets three worthy crowns. **He is not the day's other Alexander**, the soldier of Tiberianus, who has his own page and his own folder in this batch. **No year, no country and no emperor**, so there is no `dates` object and no `locations`. **The page gives the place of their synaxis** — the church of Saint Irene near the sea — which is a commemoration's place and not a feast, and is recorded in the life. No hymn is printed.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
